OpenBMC CI failed at repotest. It looks like a CI issue.

```
libgpiod: ERROR: failed to solve: process "/bin/sh -c curl -L https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/libs/libgpiod/libgpiod.git/snapshot/libgpiod-1.6.5.tar.gz | tar -xz && cd libgpiod* &&  ./autogen.sh --prefix=/usr/local --enable-bindings-cxx && make && make install" did not complete successfully: exit code: 2
```

Are these really 3 different machines (different physical boards) or are these features within a board?  If the later, please use the appropriate yocto machine features to enable the emmc and UFS builds rather than making a unique "machine" for each one.

It’s the same EVB with different storage configs (eMMC vs UFS).

I split into 3 MACHINEs mainly to make it easier for users to build the right image:
```
. setup evb-ast2700-emmc
bitbake obmc-phosphor-image
```
Please make these configure options on the same machine if it's not 3 separate boards.
Please review V27 again when you have a chance. Thanks.
I will update for AST2700 A2 EVB.
I'd rather we limit support here to A2. This is the hardware that most people will have access to. The ASPEED SDK can be used to support pre-production designs.
Agreed. Please review again, Thanks.
Since meta-zephyr is not part of upstream OpenBMC, can you confirm the plan for adding this layer?
For A2, the BootMCU will be changed from SPL to Zephyr. @patrick@stwcx.xyz Could you help us add meta-zephyr into OpenBMC?
